theorem: Breaking PSp(4,3) only to a completion-chart stabilizer does not recover a useful linear cut from the 40 regulus coordinates. The 240 oriented bad-triple-plus-omitted-line-twice witnesses are one H-orbit, and every relevant H-leaf orbit covers every witness.
consequence: This canonical chart-aware witness family cannot raise the current depth-five LP lower bound 13. A successful cut must break below the chart stabilizer or add genuinely nonlinear/integer structure.
boundary: This closes only the canonical 40-coordinate regulus witness family; it is not a no-go for every possible chart-stabilizer inequality.
